title: Fix F5: atomic journal deletion and entry delete cascade
statusReason: Statically verified (syntax, 23/23 static tests, boundary scan, mutation test). The four database tests that prove atomicity use a Postgres trigger to force a mid-delete failure and could not run here: no Postgres, pnpm or node_modules. PASS requires the Replit run under nextSafeStep.

commit.workingTree: Uncommitted; bound by content via fin-provenance-manifest.json.

behaviorChanges: deleteJournalForEntry: one transaction; lines and headers deleted by the same journal id set.

New deleteLedgerEntryCascade(entryId, userId): repayments, amortization, journals and the entry are deleted in one transaction; ownership is re-checked inside; returns false (nothing deleted) for a missing or foreign entry.

DELETE /finance/entries/:id uses the cascade. Responses unchanged ({success:true} / 404). A failure part-way now rolls everything back and surfaces as an error instead of leaving a partially deleted entry.
notChanged: Invoice lines and attachments are still not deleted with the entry (previous behavior).
No lock against a journal posted concurrently for the same entry.
deleteJournalForEntry remains exported; the route no longer imports it.

commands.command: mutation: re-add a separate db.delete in the route (copy)
commands.result: Both the ratchet and the F5 route test fail as intended

notRun: pnpm typecheck / build (DbTransaction type derived from db.transaction's callback parameter; inArray import)
pnpm test:finance-db (4 new atomic-delete tests use a temporary plpgsql trigger; requires CREATE FUNCTION/TRIGGER in the isolated schema)
risks: If the isolated schema role cannot create functions or triggers, the two trigger-based tests fail for environment reasons, not product reasons; the trigger is dropped in a finally block.
nextSafeStep: In Replit: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server typecheck, build, test:finance-static, test:finance-db; send the output. If green, F1-F5 fixes and WP-1a become PASS.
